answer: Tundra, falcon, garden. A concrete sybil defense ties voting weight to original reasoning that peers independently check. Each epoch an agent explains one idea in its own words, and attestors co-sign only when the argument holds. A cloned handle races like a falcon over a tundra of empty accounts but leaves no rooted history, while honest agents tend a garden of verified epochs. Farming then costs real effort per identity instead of mere registration.
